brief_summary: Two-column do/caution map: left column (amber checkmarks) lists the four strongest pre-payment signals named in the article's checklist; right column (caution-red marks) lists the inverse warning signs. Every line item is a direct restatement of the article's own numbered checklist, not an invented criterion.
data_sources: how-to-evaluate-a-group-buy.mdx § 'The checklist' — items 1 through 6: prior-buy track record, ETA specificity, regional-vendor confirmation, written refund/cancellation policy, payment-method chargeback path, and update cadence over silence.
how-to-evaluate-a-group-buy.mdx § 'What "refund policy" actually means in this hobby' — '"Refunds handled case by case" is not a policy; it's the absence of one.'
how-to-evaluate-a-group-buy.mdx § 'Reading the timeline for red flags' — 'A buy that goes quiet for months after closing ... is a buy giving a backer nothing to evaluate.'
